results.fact: Fin scramble season is a sentence, not a window
results.evidence: The Mount Cruiser article (the Sawtooth Ridge high point, same Flapjack Lakes base) gives June through September as the most favorable climbing weather; the peak's ascent log shows logged climbs only in July (20%), August (60%) and September (20%). Both end the season in September, matching the row's own best_season ('Late June/July through September') and optimalWindow ('Late July through September', October 'risky'). The snow-consolidation explanation is already in best_season, so season is shortened to the window and best_season is left as is.

patches.expect: Trail generally hikable mid-June through October; the high country around Sawtooth Pass is typically safest to scramble July through September/October once seasonal snow has consolidated or cleared.
patches.fact: Fin scramble season is a sentence, not a window

results.fact: Drive distance Winthrop to Andrews Creek Trailhead
results.correct_value: about 23 miles from Winthrop to the Andrews Creek Trailhead (first ~6 on West Chewuch Rd / County Rd 1213, the rest on FR 51)
results.evidence: One Cathedral Lakes trip guide says the road from Winthrop is paved for 23.5 miles to the Andrews Creek Trailhead; an independent Pasayten trail page says to drive 23 miles up the Chewuch River road to the Andrews Creek trail. A road-network route from downtown Winthrop to the row's trailhead pin (48.7837, -120.1086) measures 23.6 mi. The Forest Service directions ('6 miles ... then 22 miles') are ambiguous and were read as 28; the sibling SE Buttress row already says ~23. Fixed every copy: approach, trailhead pin directions, road.status and road.driveNote.
